algorithms.name: Alpha-beta search
algorithms.detail: Iterative deepening with quiescence, transposition table, killer moves and a history heuristic.

algorithms.name: Logistic-regression evaluation
algorithms.detail: Trained in the Python backend (engine/train.py) by stochastic gradient descent on positions distilled from a deeper teacher search; served to the browser as 16 weights.

algorithms.name: k-NN opening book
algorithms.detail: Positions from the same corpus, scored by distance-weighted k-nearest-neighbour vote over material/space/phase features.

algorithms.name: UCB1 difficulty bandit
algorithms.detail: Online: watches how close your moves are to the engine's best line and nudges the effective level up or down.

algorithms.name: History heuristic
algorithms.detail: Reinforcement over move ordering inside the search: cutoffs reorder future move lists.

algorithms.name: Stockfish 19 in WebAssembly
algorithms.detail: The two top levels hand the move to Stockfish 19 (lite, single-threaded, 1.8 MB) running as a WebAssembly worker in your browser: NNUE evaluation, a deep alpha-beta search and a proper transposition table. Level 6 is capped with Stockfish's own UCI_Elo limiter; level 7 plays at full strength. It also powers the hint button.
